content:
Structure an 8-second Seedance 2.5 sequence as a “graphic reveal” with a clear shot progression (extreme close-up → kinetic run → wide arena → character reveal → converge into symbol → symbol shatters into title) to control pacing and narrative.

Prompt for a 2D graphic motion-poster style by specifying flat black silhouettes, hot-orange + restricted cyan rim lighting, geometric UI elements, and hard-edged abstract effects to enforce a cohesive 2D theme.

Use a constrained color palette (black silhouettes + orange energy vs cyan calm) and explicitly describe the color arc (explosive orange → composed cyan → brand/title) to guide visual continuity across shots.
